name: Boundary-condition bug
description: Incorrect comparison index > len(items) allows IndexError when index == len(items).
expected_behavior: get_page_item returns None when index >= len(items).
golden_patch:
--- a/catalog.py
+++ b/catalog.py
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
 def get_page_item(items: list, index: int):
     # BUG: off-by-one boundary check (index > len(items) allows IndexError)
-    if index > len(items):
+    if index >= len(items):
         return None
     return items[index]
